newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Holtek up sharply in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Holtek up sharply in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan's Holtek Microelectronics Ltd rose sharply in late trade on Wednesday as investors bargain hunted on lower-priced semiconductor shares that had lagged the sector's recent bull run, brokers said.
With 45 minutes left, Holtek was up 4.45 percent or T$1.50 to T$35.20. Trading was a heavy 13 million shares.

Blue-chip electronic shares had risen last week on news that the U.S. semiconductor book-to-bill ratio reached a new year high in September, indicating improved outlook for an industry recently beset with oversupply.

"It was the high-priced blue-chip shares that led the bull run last week. Now, with the blue-chips fighting off profit-taking, investors have turned their attention to lower-priced shares like Holtek," said Eric Liu of National Securities.
